because: Counterexample (hunt round 2, 2026-10-10): 203.0.113.5 and ::ffff:203.0.113.5 were two keys of the cooldown set, so one host was admitted twice at one Instant under a 60 s cooldown, while the node reads both as one host. Fix: the source address is canonical from parsing on.
statement: Successful admissions of one source IP are separated by at least cooldown. A capacity or rate refusal creates neither a new cooldown nor an admitted-rate slot. Only successful admission inserts an expiry tuple and increments the quota.
